## #NameType

RFC 1123 DNS label — lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens, max 63 chars.

**At a glance**

- Source: `src/types.cue` in `opmodel.dev/core@v2`
- Shape: string constraint
- Used by: [`#Blueprint`](/docs/reference/definitions/resources-traits-and-blueprints/#blueprint), [`#CatalogMemberFQNGate`](/docs/reference/definitions/publish-gates/#catalogmemberfqngate), [`#Component`](/docs/reference/definitions/components/#component), [`#ComponentTransformer`](/docs/reference/definitions/transformers/#componenttransformer), [`#InstanceIdentity`](/docs/reference/definitions/modules-and-instances/#instanceidentity), [`#Module`](/docs/reference/definitions/modules-and-instances/#module), [`#ModuleInstance`](/docs/reference/definitions/modules-and-instances/#moduleinstance), [`#Platform`](/docs/reference/definitions/catalogs-and-platforms/#platform), [`#Resource`](/docs/reference/definitions/resources-traits-and-blueprints/#resource), [`#SecretType`](/docs/reference/definitions/secrets-and-config/#secrettype), [`#Trait`](/docs/reference/definitions/resources-traits-and-blueprints/#trait), [`#TransformerContext`](/docs/reference/definitions/transformers/#transformercontext)

**Spec**

```cue
#NameType: string & =~"^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$" & strings.MinRunes(1) & strings.MaxRunes(63)
```

**Enforcement**

CUE enforces each of these rules on a value unified with `#NameType`:

- The string must match this regular expression:

  ```text
  ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$
  ```

- The string must be 1 to 63 runes long.

## #ObjectNameType

RFC 1123 DNS subdomain — dot-separated DNS labels, max 253 runes.

**At a glance**

- Source: `src/types.cue` in `opmodel.dev/core@v2`
- Shape: string constraint
- Used by: [`#Component`](/docs/reference/definitions/components/#component), [`#ComponentNames`](/docs/reference/definitions/components/#componentnames)

**Spec**

```cue
#ObjectNameType: string & =~"^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?(\\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?)*$" & strings.MinRunes(1) & strings.MaxRunes(253)
```

**Notes**

What the API server admits for most metadata.name, and the ceiling of an explicit [`#Component.metadata.resourceName`](/docs/reference/definitions/components/#component). Never the type of anything that composes into DNS.

**Enforcement**

CUE enforces each of these rules on a value unified with `#ObjectNameType`:

- The string must match this regular expression:

  ```text
  ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?)*$
  ```

- The string must be 1 to 253 runes long.

## #ServiceNameType

RFC 1035 DNS label — [`#NameType`](/docs/reference/definitions/names-paths-and-versions/#nametype) with an alphabetic first rune.

**At a glance**

- Source: `src/types.cue` in `opmodel.dev/core@v2`
- Shape: string constraint

**Spec**

```cue
#ServiceNameType: string & =~"^[a-z]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$" & strings.MinRunes(1) & strings.MaxRunes(63)
```

**Notes**

Service metadata.name refuses a leading digit at apply, which [`#NameType`](/docs/reference/definitions/names-paths-and-versions/#nametype) admits ("1prod-web" vets clean and is refused by the server); this type refuses it at vet. Declared by the catalog's Expose trait as its `#nameConstraint` and as the type of the Service name field.

**Enforcement**

CUE enforces each of these rules on a value unified with `#ServiceNameType`:

- The string must match this regular expression:

  ```text
  ^[a-z]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$
  ```

- The string must be 1 to 63 runes long.

## #SnakeNameType

A snake_case name — lowercase alphanumeric with underscores.

**At a glance**

- Source: `src/types.cue` in `opmodel.dev/core@v2`
- Shape: string constraint
- Used by: [`#Module`](/docs/reference/definitions/modules-and-instances/#module)


Same character budget as [`#NameType`](/docs/reference/definitions/names-paths-and-versions/#nametype); differs only in the separator (`_` instead of `-`), making it a valid CUE identifier (and thus a usable CUE package name / registry-path leaf). - The string must match this regular expression:

  ```text
  ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9_]*[a-z0-9])?$
  ```

- The string must be 1 to 63 runes long.

## #ModulePathType

- Shape: string constraint

- The string must be 1 to 254 runes long.

## #ArtifactRef

`#ArtifactRef` splits a complete module path into the OCI repository its tags live under and the major it declares.

**At a glance**

- Source: `src/types.cue` in `opmodel.dev/core@v2`
- Shape: struct, closed
- Uses: [`#MajorVersionType`](/docs/reference/definitions/names-paths-and-versions/#majorversiontype), [`#ModulePathType`](/docs/reference/definitions/names-paths-and-versions/#modulepathtype), [`#PackagePathType`](/docs/reference/definitions/names-paths-and-versions/#packagepathtype)
- Used by: [`#Catalog`](/docs/reference/definitions/catalogs-and-platforms/#catalog), [`#IdentityPackage`](/docs/reference/definitions/publish-gates/#identitypackage), [`#Module`](/docs/reference/definitions/modules-and-instances/#module)

**Spec**

```cue
#ArtifactRef: {
    modulePath!: #ModulePathType

    // registryPath: the OCI repository. Tags hang off this, and it is the
    // major-free identity of the artifact's lineage. Typed #PackagePathType so
    // a value still carrying a major is refused by the type rather than
    // silently yielding a second address.
    registryPath: #PackagePathType & _p[0]

    // major: the identity-bearing version component, read rather than parsed.
    major: #MajorVersionType & _p[1]

    // importPath: what an `import` statement and a cue.mod dependency key
    // carry. modulePath verbatim — nothing is recombined.
    importPath: modulePath
}
```

**Notes**

This is the one place in the schema a module path is decomposed: every "compose an address from a prefix and a name" site collapses into reading registryPath.

**Enforcement**

CUE enforces each of these rules on a value unified with `#ArtifactRef`:

- A field the definition does not declare is refused: the definition is closed.
- A value is incomplete until each required field (`!`) is set, and CUE names the missing one when it needs a complete value: `modulePath`.


**Notes**

A module major, which the registry assigns; not a contract level ([`#APIVersionType`](/docs/reference/definitions/names-paths-and-versions/#apiversiontype)).

**Enforcement**

CUE enforces each of these rules on a value unified with `#MajorVersionType`:

- The string must match this regular expression:

  ```text
  ^v[0-9]+$
  ```


## #APIVersionType

- Shape: string constraint
- Used by: [`#APIVersionGated`](/docs/reference/definitions/names-paths-and-versions/#apiversiongated), [`#Blueprint`](/docs/reference/definitions/resources-traits-and-blueprints/#blueprint), [`#Catalog`](/docs/reference/definitions/catalogs-and-platforms/#catalog), [`#CatalogMemberFQNGate`](/docs/reference/definitions/publish-gates/#catalogmemberfqngate), [`#Resource`](/docs/reference/definitions/resources-traits-and-blueprints/#resource), [`#Trait`](/docs/reference/definitions/resources-traits-and-blueprints/#trait)

**Spec**

```cue

```


**Notes**

Admits the Kubernetes ladder: vNalphaM, vNbetaM, vN.

**Enforcement**

CUE enforces each of these rules on a value unified with `#APIVersionType`:

- The string must match this regular expression:



## #APIVersionGated

`#APIVersionGated` reports whether the additive-only promise binds at a given apiVersion: false at alpha, which promises nothing and whose publish gate is off, true at beta and GA, which are gated in full.

**At a glance**

- Source: `src/types.cue` in `opmodel.dev/core@v2`
- Shape: struct, closed
- Uses: [`#APIVersionType`](/docs/reference/definitions/names-paths-and-versions/#apiversiontype)

**Spec**

```cue
#APIVersionGated: {
    apiVersion!: #APIVersionType
    gated:       !strings.Contains(apiVersion, "alpha")
}
```

**Example**

```cue
(#APIVersionGated & {apiVersion: "v1beta1"}).gated // true
```

**Enforcement**

CUE enforces each of these rules on a value unified with `#APIVersionGated`:

- A field the definition does not declare is refused: the definition is closed.
- A value is incomplete until each required field (`!`) is set, and CUE names the missing one when it needs a complete value: `apiVersion`.
